LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.WorkPriority.Name: 9-step work priorities
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.WorkPriority.Desc: Raises the WORK tab priority cap from 4 to 9 (1 highest, 9 lowest). Clicking a cell cycles through 1-9 as before, and shift-clicking a column header shifts the whole column. New colonists start with Firefight 1, Patient 2 and everything else 5; numbers already set in existing saves are left alone.
